scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All three candidates pass the frozen hard gates; candidate 01 is selected because it gives the most source-like global cell distribution while preserving the same coherent boundary-growth tissue geometry.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 50,012-pixel joint change follows authorized external tumor-stroma interfaces; its 43,790-pixel tissue component is connected to existing tumor boundaries and preserves non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Twenty-five target-class nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 1.028, 1.021, 1.039 and 0.959, closest overall to the source distribution among the three passing alternatives.
decisions.coupling: Added nuclei remain inside the authorized changed tissue and boundary halo; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and local density checks pass with score 0.882.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The edit spans several existing external tumor-stroma interfaces rather than one focus. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.
